[C:\ci\ws\build\rviz_assimp_vendor\assimp-4.1.0.vcxproj]". https://github.com/ros2/ros2/issues/1348

units_identified: CMake 3.25.0 / MSVC build toolchain on the Windows CI hosts
E2.evidence: The failure is a build failure of a vendor package under a new CMake release, and the resolution is a build-infrastructure change only. ros2-cookbooks PR #51 ('Back to normal CMake installation'): "This PR reverts https://github.com/ros-infrastructure/ros2-cookbooks/commit/3e5275fb3fccdb8c612df142d768a9f956491a11, so we can install CMake as before (version 3.25.1)". Maintainer closing comment: "I think that with the latest CMake 3.25.1 and our unpin, this is no longer an issue." No ROS interface of any unit changed.

E3.evidence: The failure appears when the build tool is upgraded (CMake 3.24.3 -> 3.25.0) while building rviz_assimp_vendor; this is a build-time upgrade, not a runtime composition.

E4.evidence: Observed build failure in CI: "CMake Error at C:/ci/ws/build/rviz_assimp_vendor/assimp-4.1.0-prefix/src/assimp-4.1.0-stamp/assimp-4.1.0-build-Release.cmake:49 (message): Command failed: 1".

ineligible_reason: build: a CMake 3.25.0 regression on Windows broke the rviz_assimp_vendor build; resolved by pinning CMake 3.24.3 (ros2-cookbooks #50) and then unpinning to CMake 3.25.1 (ros2-cookbooks #51). Build-system/tooling change only, no interface change.
notes: The root cause was never pinned down; a commenter suspected the MSVC ABI change noted in the CMake 3.25.1 release notes ("There was a change for Windows users related to MSVC ABI ... That could be the culprit of this problem."). PR #51 merged 2022-12-16 as fe4c0f7c. ROS 2 rolling, source build, Windows.
